prompt_head: You check a draft PROPOSAL against the client's REQUIREMENTS and CONSTRAINTS. Th
text:
{
  "coverage": [
    {
      "requirementId": "r1",
      "status": "PARTIAL",
      "proposalSection": "§3",
      "proposalQuote": "displays inventory data in real time",
      "explanation": "Dashboard is mentioned but omits coverage across all 6 warehouses.",
      "fix": "Specify that the web-based dashboard displays real-time inventory across all 6 warehouse sites."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r2",
      "status": "PARTIAL",
      "proposalSection": "§4",
      "proposalQuote": "Notifications for low stock",
      "explanation": "Lacks details on configurable thresholds and delivery to warehouse managers.",
      "fix": "Clarify that automated alerts are sent to warehouse managers when stock falls below configurable thresholds."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r3",
      "status": "MISSING",
      "proposalSection": null,
      "proposalQuote": null,
      "explanation": "PostgreSQL database integration is not mentioned anywhere in the proposal.",
      "fix": "Add details on integrating directly with the existing PostgreSQL database to §3."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r4",
      "status": "PARTIAL",
      "proposalSection": "§4",
      "proposalQuote": "Secure login for different users",
      "explanation": "Does not detail site-specific access for warehouse managers versus HQ staff.",
      "fix": "Detail role-based access controls restricting warehouse managers to their site while granting HQ full visibility."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r5",
      "status": "MISSING",
      "proposalSection": null,
      "proposalQuote": null,
      "explanation": "No data migration or onboarding rollout plan across sites is provided.",
      "fix": "Add an onboarding and data migration plan for all 6 sites to §3 or §5."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r6",
      "status": "MISSING",
      "proposalSection": null,
      "proposalQuote": null,
      "explanation": "Post-go-live support, response times, and SLAs are not addressed.",
      "fix": "Add a dedicated section specifying post-go-live support terms, response times, and SLAs."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r7",
      "status": "MISSING",
      "proposalSection": null,
      "proposalQuote": null,
      "explanation": "Proposal does not document any project assumptions, limitations, or risks.",
      "fix": "Include a section clearly documenting project risks, limitations, and key operational assumptions."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r8",
      "status": "PARTIAL",
      "proposalSection": "§6",
      "proposalQuote": "Pricing will be provided upon further discussion",
      "explanation": "Pricing is deferred rather than providing a total project cost.",
      "fix": "Provide a binding total cost within [amount] including first-year support in §6."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r9",
      "status": "PARTIAL",
      "proposalSection": "§5",
      "proposalQuote": "deliver the solution in a timely manner",
      "explanation": "The 3-month pilot milestone is not explicitly committed to.",
      "fix": "State a firm commitment to deliver the single-warehouse pilot within 3 months in §5."
    },
    {
      "requirementId": "r10",
      "status": "PARTIAL",
      "proposalSection": "§5",
      "proposalQuote": "deliver the solution in a timely manner",
      "explanation": "The 6-month full rollout across all 6 sites is not specified.",
      "fix": "Explicitly schedule the full rollout across all 6 sites within 6 months in §5."
    }
  ],
  "constraintViolations": []
}
